Search built around judgment, not volume.

Aurelis Search Partners approaches senior appointments through careful market mapping, direct executive engagement, and a considered assessment of leadership context, rather than high-volume applicant processing.

Many of our assignments involve senior executives who are not actively seeking a move, and board candidates who must be identified through targeted research rather than conventional sourcing.

We take on a limited number of mandates at any time, so that our attention matches the seniority of the search.

Board & Governance Search

We advise boards, foundations, professional bodies, and healthcare and other institutions on identifying qualified individuals for governance-level appointments.

Independence, judgment, and perspective, assessed against the mandate.

Board searches require a different methodology from conventional executive recruitment. We consider governance experience, sector expertise, strategic perspective, committee relevance, independence, and potential conflicts of interest alongside institutional relationships and long-term board contribution.

We identify individuals whose experience, judgment, independence, and perspective align with the governance requirements of the mandate.

  • Independent Director appointments
  • Board of Trustees positions
  • Advisory board appointments
  • Governance committee requirements & committee leadership
  • Specialized, sector-specific board mandates

Search Approach

A disciplined, six-stage methodology applied to every mandate, whether executive or governance in nature.

01

Mandate Definition

Understand the organization's strategic objectives, leadership requirements, governance considerations, and success profile.

02

Market Mapping

Research the relevant executive and board talent landscape and identify individuals whose backgrounds correspond to the mandate.

03

Confidential Outreach

Approach selected executives and governance candidates discreetly, providing sufficient context for them to evaluate the opportunity.

04

Assessment

Evaluate experience, leadership scope, governance relevance, motivations, potential conflicts, and alignment with the mandate.

05

Candidate Positioning

Present qualified candidates in a structured manner that clearly communicates the relevance of their experience to the organization or board.

06

Process Management

Support the confidential search process through candidate communication, coordination, diligence, and ongoing engagement.

Discretion is part of the mandate.

Senior leadership searches often involve individuals who are not actively seeking a move. Board appointments can be equally sensitive, particularly when candidates hold existing governance, institutional, or professional relationships. Our approach is designed around discretion, from the first conversation through the conclusion of the search.
